title: Practice 4: за and под: going behind, under

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Вечером малиновый шар солнца опускается за ___ (дымка, acc. sg.) горизонта.
exercises.prompt: In the evening, the crimson sphere of the sun descends beyond the haze of the horizon.
exercises.why: **дымка → дымку** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. дымка · дымки · дымке · дымку · дымкой · дымке; pl. дымки · дымок · дымкам · дымки · дымками · дымках.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Вы, конечно, были в субботу под ___ (воскресенье, acc. sg.) здесь?
exercises.why: **воскресенье → воскресенье** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -е. Declines like DLI's поле — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. поле). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. воскресенье · воскресенья · воскресенью · воскресенье · воскресеньем · воскресенье; pl. воскресенья · воскресений · воскресеньям · воскресенья · воскресеньями · воскресеньях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Очень вам благодарен за ___ (любезность, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Thank you very much for your kindness.
exercises.why: **любезность → любезность** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ь. Declines like DLI's часть — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. часть). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. любезность · любезности · любезности · любезность · любезностью · любезности; pl. любезности · любезностей · любезностям · любезности · любезностями · любезностях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я, маточка, под ___ (колесо, acc. pl.) брошусь; я вас не пущу уезжать!
exercises.why: **колесо → колёса** (acc. pl.). Neuter, inanimate; nominative plural колёса. Ending -о → -а.  Declension: sg. колесо · колеса · колесу · колесо · колесом · колесе; pl. колёса · колёс · колёсам · колёса · колёсами · колёсах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том получил тройку за ___ (тест, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom got a D on his test.
exercises.why: **тест → тест** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. тест · теста · тесту · тест · тестом · тесте; pl. тесты · тестов · тестам · тесты · тестами · тестах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Положили мы его под ___ (образ, acc. pl.).
exercises.why: **образ → образа** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural образа. Declines like DLI's дом — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. дома). Ending — (no ending) → -а.  Declension: sg. образ · образа · образу · образ · образом · образе; pl. образа · образов · образам · образа · образами · образах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Встряхнитесь! Вы за ___ (вся неделя, acc. sg.) ничего не сделали.
exercises.prompt: Snap out of it! You haven't done a thing all week.
exercises.why: **неделя → неделю** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я. Declines like DLI's неделя — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. неделю). Ending -я → -ю.  **весь → всю** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with неделю). «весь» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (f. sg.): вся · всей · всей · всю · всей · всей.  Declension: sg. неделя · недели · неделе · неделю · неделей · неделе; pl. недели · недель · неделям · недели · неделями · неделях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Царский под ___ (ноготь, acc. sg.), а студенческий показать.

Declension: sg. ноготь · ногтя · ногтю · ноготь · ногтем · ногте; pl. ногти · ногтей · ногтям · ногти · ногтями · ногтях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **расстрел → расстрел** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). exercises.q: Что это за ___ (холмик, acc. sg.) посреди поля?
exercises.prompt: What is that little mound in the middle of the field?
exercises.why: **холмик → холмик** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). exercises.q: Это вы поставили его под ___ (выстрел, acc. sg.), вы!
exercises.why: **выстрел → выстрел** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. выстрел · выстрела · выстрелу · выстрел · выстрелом · выстреле; pl. выстрелы · выстрелов · выстрелам · выстрелы · выстрелами · выстрелах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. **родина → родину** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. родина · родины · родине · родину · родиной · родине; pl. родины · родин · родинам · родины · родинами · родинах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Выбор мест под ___ (новый, acc. pl.) селения.
exercises.why: **новый → новые** (acc. pl., agreeing with селения). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension of новый (plural): новые · новых · новым · новые (inan.) / новых (anim.) · новыми · новых.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Две фирмы конкурируют друг с другом за ___ (лидерство, acc. sg.) на рынке.
exercises.prompt: Two firms compete with each other for market leadership.
exercises.why: **лидерство → лидерство** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о. Declines like DLI's окно — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. лидерство · лидерства · лидерству · лидерство · лидерством · лидерстве; pl. лидерства · лидерств · лидерствам · лидерства · лидерствами · лидерствах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Начал я пиво пить, сигары курю, живу под ___ (немец, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **немец → немца** (acc. sg.). Masculine, animate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's студент — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. студента). Ending — (no ending) → -а, with the fleeting -е- of the stem dropped: немц- + -а.  Declension: sg. немец · немца · немцу · немца · немцем · немце; pl. немцы · немцев · немцам · немцев · немцами · немцах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «Certain masculine nouns have the vowels е or о only in the nominative singular (and in the accusative if inanimate): отец — отца, американец — американца, кусок — куска, звонок — звонка.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
